_variance_source: R1 development-stage pilot (experiments/r1/prelock_diagnostics.json): D_vs_B scenario-level SD 0.282, within-scenario seed SD 0.180 over 45 development/validation scenarios x 4 seeds. metric_sd_between_scenarios rounded UP to 0.30 (conservative). Locked-test outcomes NOT used.
_tie_caveat: simulate_power does not model exact ties; the dev pilot shows ~31% exact D=B ties, so achieved power is somewhat below the simulated value. The report states n_nonzero and the observed tie rate; a non-significant D_vs_B is reported as 'no significant incremental improvement detected', never as equivalence.
